title: Add chunk-stability metric and model-hotspot Sankey dashboard
author: Asha Menon
description: Background: streaming stability incidents in November showed a pattern where certain invocations produced interleaved or duplicated chunks that triggered retries and inflight reassembly logic, inflating token cost and tail latency for a subset of models and routes. This PR introduces two observability primitives to make that behavior visible and actionable: 1) a chunk-stability metric family that quantifies per-route and per-model chunk jitter, duplication and reordering; 2) a model-hotspot Sankey dashboard that attributes token cost and latency to model routing/fallback paths and surface persistent hotspots across tenants. Motivation: current dashboards surface per-token cost and per-invocation latency distributions, but they do not make streaming chunk instability or cross-model fallback flows explicit. The lack of these signals delays mitigations (rate-limit adjustments, streaming retry fixups, and targeted model pinning). Changes: - Add metrics/chunk_stability.go: exporter that emits three new counters/gauges per invocation: chunk_jitter_ms_p90, chunk_dup_rate, chunk_reorder_rate. These are computed in the stream reassembler with a light-weight reservoir for p90 estimations. - Instrument streaming runtime (stream/reassembler) to increment and tag the new metrics with route, model_variant, tenant_id (hashed), and sequence_shape (single-chunk, multi-chunk-short, multi-chunk-long). - Add histogram labels for chunk_size_bytes to help spot fragmentation patterns. - Add dashboards/model_hotspot_sankey.json: Grafana panel set that renders a Sankey-style flow from ingress route -> model variant -> fallback model -> post-processing stage, weighted by aggregated token-cost and median rendering latency. Includes link-outs to sample traces filtered by the top 3 flows. - Add dashboards/streaming_chunk_troubleshooter.json: troubleshooting page with sparkline of chunk_dup_rate over time + top contributing routes and the first-seen example trace id column for quick drill-in. - Add tests/observability/test_chunk_stability_exporter.go: unit and integration tests validating metric labels and aggregation behavior under synthetic reorder/dup scenarios. - Add docs/obs/chunk-stability.md: usage doc describing the metric semantics, suggested alerts (see below), and remediation steps. - Add small change to telemetry/rollups to preserve chunk labels for 7 days (configurable). Implementation notes: - The chunk-stability metrics are intentionally aggregated at the exporter edge to avoid per-token cardinality explosion. We hash tenant IDs and trim route/model labels for high-cardinality routes. - p90 reservoir is bounded to 1024 samples per minute window; we experimented with reservoir sizes and chose this tradeoff based on a replay of the canary workload. - The Sankey dashboard uses a precomputed daily rollup index to drive the flows; real-time panels pull from the 5m window when available. Testing and CI: - Local unit tests added and passing. - Integration run on staging with a replay of synthetic streaming anomalies showed the chunk_dup_rate rising in the expected routes and the Sankey highlighting the retry->fallback->postproc path. - CI: all checks passed after a lint cleanup iteration (flake8/golangci-lint) and a small timeout adjustment to an existing telemetry integration test. Alerts (recommended): - Alert: streaming.chunk_dup_rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m on production routes (sev-2) - Alert: chunk_jitter_ms_p90 > 250ms for any paid tier route for 5m (investigate network vs runtime scheduling) - Auto-suppression: exclude synthetic/replay traffic via the new "replay_source" label. Rollout plan: - Feature flagged off by default. - Enable in staging and run synthetic anomaly replay for 48h. - Enable for 10% of production routes (internal flag) for one week; monitor top flows and adjust reservoir sizing if needed. - Full rollout after one-week validation. Backwards compatibility and perf: - The extra instrumentation in the reassembler is micro-optimized to use a lock-free ring buffer and a per-shard aggregator so expected latency impact is <0.2ms p50 on the hot path in our microbenchmarks. - Metrics cardinality controls are conservative; if teams need higher fidelity we provide a per-tenant opt-in. Related work: draws on ideas from ENG-3121 (streaming retry visibility) and ENG-2987 (per-route cost attribution). See linked Linear items.

review_comments: Diego Ramos: Left a couple of nits around label cardinality — can we prefix hashed_tenant to make queries clearer?
Asha Menon: Updated hashing prefix and pushed a follow-up commit to normalize tenant label length.
Maya Chen: Could we add a short-circuit to skip reservoir sampling for single-chunk invocations? That would reduce noise for small requests.
Asha Menon: Added check to bypass reservoir for sequence_shape == single-chunk; re-ran staging replay, results unchanged besides reduced metric churn.
Oliver Grant (approval): Verified staging replay and CI; performance microbenchmarks look good. Approving for gradual rollout.

release_notes: Added streaming chunk-stability metrics and two dashboards: model-hotspot Sankey and streaming chunk troubleshooter. Introduces alerts for chunk duplication and 90th percentile chunk jitter. Feature is behind a flag and rolled out gradually.
notes_for_future: If chunk_dup_rate is high but traces show network layer problems, consider enabling the network-probe profiler in the reassembler. We may also add an optional per-tenant full-fidelity mode for debugging.
